about: Built by tools/build_tennis.py. The grounds are traced from the International Tennis Hall of Fame’s own 2026 site map (north is to the right on it; turned here so north is up). The museum on the Casino’s second floor has no published plan: its galleries are placed approximately.
source: Grounds: the International Tennis Hall of Fame’s 2026 site map, turned north-up; museum floor approximate, from the Hall of Fame’s descriptions of its galleries
units: site-map pixels, about 0.17 m, north up
